entries.predicate: sqlite_version() is 3.51.0 (macOS system libsqlite) or 3.53.0 (Bun Linux/Windows amalgamation)
entries.specifiedBehavior: Harness bootstrap asserts sqlite_version() is in {3.51.0, 3.53.0}. Dialect tests are version-tagged when 3.51≠3.53.

entries.predicate: snapshot().encode() bytes are SQLM, not a .sqlite file
entries.specifiedBehavior: Custom codec; logical Dump after Snapshot.open matches pre-snapshot Dump.

entries.predicate: default random() and date('now') are seeded/fixed
entries.specifiedBehavior: PRNG seed default 1; clock 2000-01-01T00:00:00.000Z unless random:os / now:system.

entries.predicate: IEEE -0 becomes +0 on bind, affinity, and arithmetic
entries.specifiedBehavior: Object.is(result, -0) is false for bound and computed zeros.

entries.predicate: ATTACH filename is ignored; attached schema is empty in-memory
entries.specifiedBehavior: ATTACH creates an empty schema; no file contents are loaded.

entries.predicate: EXPLAIN / EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN shapes are stubs
entries.specifiedBehavior: Plan text is not byte-identical to SQLite bytecode; results of the explained statement still match.

entries.predicate: INDEXED BY / NOT INDEXED is accepted and ignored
entries.specifiedBehavior: Query results match the unhinted plan; missing-index errors are not raised.

entries.predicate: MATERIALIZED / NOT MATERIALIZED do not change the execution strategy
entries.specifiedBehavior: Results still match the oracle; both hints take the materialized CTE path.

entries.predicate: FTS shadow-table change counters may differ from bun:sqlite
entries.specifiedBehavior: MATCH results and rank order still match; db.changes after FTS maintenance may differ.

entries.predicate: pragma_compile_options and function_list contents are sqlite-mem's
entries.specifiedBehavior: Names and flags describe this engine, not the oracle amalgamation.

entries.predicate: better-sqlite3 extras are absent; duplicate column names collapse in row objects
entries.specifiedBehavior: bind/iterate/pluck/raw/pragma()/loadExtension/serialize/safeIntegers throw. stmt.result().values keeps positional duplicates.

entries.predicate: triggers, ATTACH, virtual tables, and user_version are not in SQLM
entries.specifiedBehavior: decode().open() outcome is pinned per omitted feature.

entries.predicate: JSON subtype is unwrapped to JS string at the API
entries.specifiedBehavior: query() returns TEXT, not a JSON wrapper object.

entries.predicate: JS NaN and Infinity binds are rejected
entries.specifiedBehavior: datatype_mismatch rather than storing NULL or Inf.

entries.predicate: SQLite may treat unknown double-quoted identifiers as strings; sqlite-mem rejects them
entries.specifiedBehavior: prepare/query of SELECT "not_a_column" throws in sqlite-mem.

entries.predicate: JS lone surrogates in string binds are engine-defined
entries.specifiedBehavior: sqlite-mem stores the JS string as UTF-16-unpaired text; oracle may replace or error.

entries.predicate: user_version is not encoded in SQLM
entries.specifiedBehavior: PRAGMA user_version after decode().open() is the default unless re-set.

entries.predicate: Some pragma setters are accepted but do not change engine state yet
entries.specifiedBehavior: defer_foreign_keys, recursive_triggers, and application_id getters remain 0 after SET.

entries.predicate: generate_series is a sqlite-mem extension
entries.specifiedBehavior: Present in sqlite-mem; not claimed vs bun:sqlite default inventory.

entries.predicate: localtime/utc modifiers do not apply host timezone conversion
entries.specifiedBehavior: Modifiers are accepted as no-ops; storage remains UTC-like fixed strings.
